Kurt was born in Great Falls and graduated from high school in Miles City. Growing up across Montana taught him the values of hard work, faith, and service. Kurt spent his career serving Montanans as a prosecutor, budget watchdog, and public servant. Over the years that's meant balancing the state's budget, cutting taxes for working families, cracking down on crime, and defending our values.
Montana is his home. Now he's running for U.S. Senate to make life more affordable, keep our communities safe, and protect our Montana way of life. Get to know the man behind the record. Learn more about Kurt Alme.
